_comment: Agent Catalog Data Document — Work Stream F2 (Phase B)
Security: this file is version-controlled and reviewed in PRs.
Never modify directly in production — changes must go through PR + CI pipeline.
Loaded into OPA as data.agent_catalog_data at startup.
Caller identity (sub) is the OIDC sub claim or SPIFFE ID from mTLS peer certificate.
GCP Adaptation: when using GCP Workload Identity, sub is the service account email.

spiffe://trust-domain/ns/default/sa/trad.description: Executes governed trade orders within RBAC-enforced limits

spiffe://trust-domain/ns/default/sa/risk.description: Performs risk assessment and portfolio analysis (read-only)

spiffe://trust-domain/ns/default/sa/data.description: Performs data analysis and reporting (read-only, no trade execution)

spiffe://trust-domain/ns/default/sa/supe.description: Orchestrates sub-agents; cannot execute trades directly
